source: Separate local benchmark run processes with one warmup and one measured response each; raw reports retained outside the repository
limitations: Exact complete prompt tokens only; no arbitrary shared-prefix reuse or cross-process reuse
A different prompt or disabled storage must execute all remote prefill stages
Repeats are visible in the provider traffic pattern; cached state and logits are held in trusted-client memory
The one-output-token response selects from prefill logits and does not execute decode stages
One matched pair does not establish representative latency or CPU savings
Full wire, peak client memory, energy, production operator separation and whole-generation quality are unmeasured
